content: Eibraham i vaŋgwa Ketura
Eibraham mbowo i vaŋguva wevo eunda na levo, idae Ketura.
I ghambɨ weiye Eibraham na le ŋgaŋgaŋgiya Jimran, Joksan, Medan, Midiyan, Isɨbak na Sua.
Joksan le ŋgaŋgaŋgiya Siba na Didan. Didan orumburumbuyeŋgiya Asur gharɨgharɨniye, Letus gharɨgharɨniye na Leyum gharɨgharɨniye.
Midiyan le ŋgaŋgaŋgiya Epa, Ipa, Hanok, Abida na Elda. Gharɨgharɨke thiyake Ketura orumburumbuyeŋgi.
Eibraham i valawe ghayayaoko laghɨye weya nariye Aisake.
Eibraham vambe elaghalagha i giyava Sera ghaemaruwoŋgiko lenji ŋgaŋga ghɨmoghɨmoru ghanjimwaewo, na i variyeyathuŋgi na thɨ wa e boimako vethɨ yakuwe na thava thɨ yaku na regha weinji nariye Aisake.
Eibraham le mare utuutuniye
Eibraham yawaliye va i molao. Ghatheghathegha vama i wo hothaŋarɨ hwepirɨ na umbolima (175) amba i rumbo vuna ghandɨghe.
Vama i amalaghɨsarɨ moli, amba i garalawa, ŋgoreiye eŋge orumburumbuyeko.
Aisake na ghaghae Ismel thɨ bekwa ramanji Eibraham e maŋgavarɨma Makpela e tɨne, Memri ghadidiye. Maŋgavarɨko iyako ina e thelau regha Eibraham va i vamodo weya rara Het idae Eipron, Joha nariye.
Eibraham vambe i bekwa levo Sera iya e maŋgavarɨko iyako.
Eibraham le mare e ghereiye, Loi va i mwaewowe nariye Aisake. Na Aisake va i wa na ve yaku Beya Lahai Roi evasiwae.
Ismel orumburumbuye
Iyake Eibraham nariye Ismel utuutuniye. Va i ghambɨ weiye Heiga tɨnan Ijipt, elaghɨniye Sera le rakakaiwobwaga.
Ismel le ŋgaŋga iya idaidanjiyake: Nebaiyot, iye virɨviva, Keda, Adɨbil, Mibɨsam,
Misɨma, Dama, Mesa,
Haded, Tema, Jeturɨ, Nepis na Kedema.
Wabwi theyaworo na theghewo orumburumbunjiŋgiya thiyake, na idaidanji te vambe thɨ renɨva ghambaghambanjiko na lenji kiyamuŋgi.
Ismel yawaliye le molamolao theghathegha hothaŋarɨ, hweto na umbopirɨ (137); ko amba i rumbo vuna ghandɨghe, ŋgoreiye eŋge orumburumbuyeko.

Orumburumbuye va thɨ yaku Havila na Sur e ghanjilughawoghawo, Ijipt valɨvaŋga i vorovoro e boimako, i ghembeghembe Asiriya. Mava thɨ yaku na ghamwanji vanaora weinjiyaŋgiya Eibraham orumburumbuye vavanava.
Iso na Jeikob lenji virɨ utuniye
Utuutuke iyake Eibraham nariya Aisake utuniye.
Aisake ghatheghathegha vama i wo hwevarɨ amba i ghe weiye Rebeka wevoko iyako Betuwel (rara Aram, Mesopoteimiya e tɨne) yawarumbuye, na elaghɨniye Leiban louye.
Kaiwae Rebeka va i kwama, le ghɨmoru Aisake i naŋgo weya Giya Loi kaiwae. Giya Loi va i vamboromboro le naŋgoko na kaero i thɨn.
Kaiwae va gamwaruwoŋgi, gamagaiko thɨ vevovewoŋgi e ŋgamoiye, iya kaiwae iŋa, “Aee, buda kaiwae gamagaike thɨ vakatha kamwathɨke iyake e ghino?” Iwaeŋge ve tamweya gharumwaru weya Giya Loi.
Giya Loi i dagewe iŋa,

content.text: gharɨgharɨna theghewona ne u ghambɨŋgi ne wabwi theghewoŋgi
Nasiyeniyena le vurɨgheghe ne i kivwala laghɨyeniyena,
Virɨvivana ne i kaiwo weya virɨ reghambana.”

content: Mbaŋa ŋgamoiye i njivun kaero i ghambɨŋgiya gamwaruworuwo ghɨmoghɨmoruŋgi.
Virɨviva va waranjaghanjagha na riwae vulivuliye ŋgoreiya kwama udauda, iya kaiwae thɨ rena idae Iso.
Theghewoniye i virɨ, ko iyemaeŋge vambe i vinjimbɨ vara virɨ vivako ghe daŋavwa, iya kaiwae thɨ rena idae Jeikob.
Aisake ghatheghathegha vama i wo hwewona (60) na mbaŋa Rebeka i ghambɨŋgiya gamagaiko theghewoko.
Gamagaiko thɨ tabo na kaero bobomaŋgi, Iso iye ra wowoidi thovuye na masemburu na nuwanuwa woidi. Ko iyemaeŋge Jeikob iye va riwouda na vambe rara vara thotho.
Aisake va i gharethovu weya Iso, kaiwae nuwae va i ghaŋgo weya thetheghanɨko va ve gabogaboko, ko Rebeka va i gharethovu weya Jeikob.
Mbaŋa regha Jeikob vama i gaga ghileghilema na Iso ghe mbaŋa vara i vuthawe, i mena e njamnjam. Ghare vama i basi.
I dage weya Jeikob iŋa, “Nɨman i maya na u giyama bigina sosorona seiwo ya ghan.” (Iya kaiwae va thɨ rena idae Idom.)
Jeikob i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Ne ya giya e ghen, thoŋgo u vatomwa virɨvivana ghe mbaro e ghino.”
Iso iŋa, “Kaero u thuweŋgo? Mbaŋa nasiye ya marenjaŋgu. Virɨ viva ghe mbaro ne i woveŋgwa budakai?”
Jeikob i gonjoghawe iŋa, “I viva wo u tholo na u dagerawe emunjoru ne u vatomwe virɨvivana ghe mbaro e ghino.” Iso kaero i tholo na i vatomwa virɨ vivama ghe mbaro weya Jeikob.
Amba Jeikob i giya bred na ghileghilema weya Iso. I ghanɨŋga na i muna mbwa, ko amba i yondovirɨ na i wa. Iso mava i goru weya virɨ viva ghambaro.

footnotes.text: Mbwata Iso gharumwaru “riwae vulivuliye”. Iso ida regha Idom, iya gharumwaru “sosoro”.
Idake Jeikob ghaloŋwaloŋwa ŋgoreiye “ghe daŋavwa” na tembe gharumwaruva “rakwan”.
